title: Intent
description: A structured statement of what the user wants. Inert data: it grants no authority and performs no action. It becomes actionable only after registry validation and a permission decision.

action.description: A capability id, dotted and lowercase.

args.description: Capability-specific arguments, validated against the capability's input schema.

source.description: The origin of the intent. Origin is separate from permission: it informs the permission decision.

confidence.description: How confident the producer is, 0..1. Deterministic producers report 1.
